about: AI tutor eval set. Each case: a question on a page; 'tool' must be called; 'expect' lists numbers the answer must contain (value from the named tool field, or a literal), each matched within 'rel' (also as /1000 or ×1000 for kW↔MW, kN↔MN); 'contains_any' lists words of which one must appear. Run: python scripts/tutor_eval.py
